thread:
oliver: Heads-up: discovered a small token-count regression impacting some invoices after last night's ingest. billing-bot: Alert: 6 accounts missing ~31,400 tokens.
maria: Opening thread for postmortem follow-up and action tracking. Who can own the backfill and ledger reconcile?
sophie: I'll lead remediation. Plan: targeted backfill for affected partitions (job bf-9002), reconcile ledger, then propose invoice adjustments. ETA Mon EOD.
dan: I can run ledger verification after Sophie's backfill and produce a ledger-diff CSV.
ops-lead: Root cause looks like compaction-triggered write throttling. There's an infra PR to add an index and tune compaction: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/2555. Assigning infra to own long-term fix.
sophie: For backfill I'll run 12-min chunks to avoid compaction windows. Dry-run first:
```
./tools/backfill --job bf-9002 --chunk 12m --dry-run
```
then live run. Acceptance criteria: ledger parity, backfill logs uploaded, and audit trail for any invoice credits.
maria: I'll draft customer comms for any credits >$200 and coordinate with Sales.
billing-bot: Backfill queued: job_id=bf-9002 status=pending region=us-east estimate=30m.
ops-lead: Add this incident to tracker and mark "recurring-pattern" so SRE schedules follow-up. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/pm-499.
sophie: Posting runbook to postmortem doc and will update here when bf-9002 completes.
maria: Recap timeline: Sophie backfill Mon EOD, Dan reconcile Tue AM, Maria customer comms Tue AM. Thanks all :thumbsup:
